en: Ah yes, here we are. Most of it is lost, but I've managed to pick out enough to get a vague idea.
Aside from that, if you'd like me to look at anything unusual, I'd love a chance to give it a once over.
Forget

Gloried one in Sunken Sea,
 Lord Leviathan is he.
Hear our Voices, Dry Above
Echo Through the Brine our Love.
Halex ends up being neither Lux nor Pox, but something more like Arcus, the most basic magic used by trainees. It is, however, a violent spell, causing a large, damaging explosion on its target.
I am trying to discover if there is an original, core version. Call it a pet project if you will.
I can feel the power in this book without even reading it! Though, that's strange. All the pages are there, but it still seems incomplete. I wonder what's missing.
I have never seen someone who dared put words such as these to print.
I've also noticed that all of the copies I've found are slightly different, almost as though every printer made unique changes.
I've several books that make reference to this one, but never imagined that I would actually see it. I'm almost disappointed. I expected something... grander, perhaps.
If there really is some connection between Leviathan and the monarchy of Lukatt, you may find more information somewhere inside the caldera.
If you are skilled enough to know the secrets of Arximum, you can expand the explosion of Halex even further. Fearsome indeed.
If you change your mind, I would still like to buy it, but we'll negotiate a more reasonable price.
If you come across any copies of the Sumptuous Garden, bring them to me and I will give you a good price for them.
If you ever run into large hordes of zombies or skeletons, Solaris will make short work of them, exploding one and catching many others in the blast.
It appears to be a series of prayers and rituals devoted to a being called Leviathan. What's more, it appears that these rituals and prayers are reserved only for royalty. Curious.
It is very badly damaged, but with any luck, a bit of catalyst will bring the ink residue out enough for us to read it. I'm sure I have some around here somewhere. Give me a moment.
It's a bit hard to make out most of this. Seems to be excerpts from a spellbook. It might be more useful if you could find more of them and compile them.
It's a... pillow book, I guess you'd say. Very common, I've noticed.
It's exceedingly common, I've noticed.
Lux is the magic of light, and of the thundering heavens. You could use this to gift your allies with heavenly grace, or daze your enemies. Demons and undead fear it, as I understand.

Max is the magic of chaos and destruction. With this your allies' attacks will throw enemies off-balance, or you could inflict pain that limits the effectiveness of healing. Shapeshifters and innocents are especially vulnerable.

Nix is the magic of eldritch mystery and transformation. With this book, you could improve your allies' spells, or pin your enemies beneath a magic nexus. Works especially well against demons and animals, I'm told.
No matter. Halex was... an experiment of sorts. An attempt to weave Lux and Pox together in a harmonious way. Whether or not the experiment was a success is perhaps up for some debate.
No... no you're right. What was I thinking? That's an absurd price for any book. Thank you.
Oh hello again. Have you found any books for me?
Oh, goodness. Where did you find this? The spells on these pages feel almost as though they are trying to cast themselves, like they need only the slightest push.
Oh, magnificent! I'll warrant that this is more than you'd get from any other vendor! Thank you again!
Pox is the magic of death and pestilence. It can cloak your allies in oily shadows, making them hard to see, or infect your enemies with withering poison. Animals and innocents particularly fear it.

Rex is the magic of life and wild, animal power. You can use this to improve your allies' physical attacks, or to impede your enemies' movements. Effective against undead and shapeshifters especially.
Solaris harnesses the power of the sun. To most creatures, this simply means violent flames, but with undead creatures such as zombies or vampires, the results are especially violent.

Something you may find interesting is that, unlike other large-area magic, Halex does not cause lesser damage to those further from the blast point. If you target the most magic-vulnerable enemy in a group, its magic-resistant fellows will be injured just as badly.
Surely it would be illegal in many places for me to buy this book. I could, however, give you a gift of 12000$ if you just forget it on the table here.
The rest of the book, I'm afraid, is well-ruined, but disturbing as that was, I'm glad to have had the opportunity to see it. Let me give you a little something for the privilege.
The royal castle, or some other place where the royal family might have spent time would be your best bet.

The verses in this book are dark indeed, insane prayers to alien gods. There's also a name - Fastad. If I recall he was once a minister in the old government. This would be a fairly scandalous find if that government were still in operation.

There are bandits and worse swarming the ruins of the noble manors and the slums of the capital, but if you're lucky, you might find something they overlooked. After all, bandits care more for gold than for print.
This Leviathan is the

This author! This is the one who wrote The Sumptuous Garden! I'd recognize this writing style anywhere. Something is different, though. Sumptuous Garden seems positively prudish compared to the depravity described here!
This is interesting. I can't say I understand all of this, but there are clearly some glimpses of mad genius here. A few holes still, but if you can close them, you'll have an object of real power.
Welcome, welcome! You don't look like the sort to spend a lot of money on books, so I'll ask straight away. Have you ever seen a copy of a book called 'Sumptuous Garden'?
Wha... where on earth did you find such a thing? Remarkable! It must be centuries old.
What on earth is this? The Commanding Oak? Let's have a look then.
Yes, I would still very much like to buy the book if you are willing to part with it. My offer is 4000$.
Another way, ye will not find. The forest covers its secrets in shame.
Furthermore, the supplies we're supposed to be getting in haven't showed up. How am I supposed to mix potions without reagents?
Go and witness the horror! It shall be engraved upon your very soul!

I euthanized four patients today. Even if we come up with a viable treatment for the plague tomorrow, some of these people are already too far gone to survive. We are running out of places to put the bodies.

I hope that the researchers at the capital are having better luck than we are. By now, all of the doctors are infected as well, myself included, and at the rate things are progressing, we will all be dead before finding a cure. I must have faith that Her Majesty will find a way to save us.

I may be able to fashion regenerative talismans as a stopgap, but we do not have the resources to create enough for all of the victims. I believe these would best be used to preserve the lives of myself and the other researchers, in the interest of continuing our work to find a cure.

I yet linger in order to remember, for if I forget, the mem'ry be lost. Heed me, travelers! If wish ye a way through the wood, witness my suff'ring! Remember in my stead, that I might sleep. Do this, and I will show you the way through.
Magical treatment appears to be effective in the earliest stages of infection, before damage has been done to the body, but once ulcers have appeared, the spells do little but slow it down.
Make sure that you check the refugees. If any of them got ahold of a key, we could have a break in quarantine, and I don't need to tell you how bad that would be.

Medicinal treatment is not making progress. I thought the previous treatment was more effective at halting symptoms, but overall survivability was not improved. I will try a new mixture tomorrow, but I am running out of ideas.
Quarantine Zone
Six subjects undergoing experimentation all died. Purging magic seemed effective in the short term, but symptoms reappeared within a few hours. Will gather more volunteers tomorrow.
The forest grows tight 'round this place, choking the pain, choking the mem'ry of what transpired.
Hey! Keep it down in there! I'm trying to organize some paperwork and you're making it really hard to concentrate!

Hmm... confiscate it, and throw them in the dungeon.
I'll decide what to with them later.
Now, if you want to keep yourself in one piece, stay where you are with your arms up. You are severely outnumbered.

Oh heck... well, we'll keep them in the dungeon for now, anyway.
I'll decide what to with them later.
Ooh-hoo-hoo! There's a nice handful of gold here, miss!
There's nothin' 'ere really worth takin', miss...
They're trying to escape! Get them!
Well, I'm almost impressed anyway. We really need something better than that old tree to hide the entrance to our base...
Well, well. I am impressed that you managed to find our little hideaway.
What the hell is going on in there?!

The treasure's gone and all is taken
My sack filled with wonderous loot
And now it's time to move my bacon
Off I go, it's time to scoot!
And allow you to roam free to spread your wickedness as you please? No, demon! You shall be put down where you stand, in the name of God!
And only newly born. Imagine the power, had he been allowed to mature! Such a waste.
And so you force my first moments to be violent? So be it, then.
By our righteous hand, you are banished, demon! Trouble this realm no more!
Good. I thank you.
I have been reborn. Move aside, and I shall leave you in peace.
I've cleared out the other room and pulled up the floor so I can begin my dig in earnest. I don't know what I'll find down there, but my gut tells me this is what I need to do.
I've hit some kind of brickwork. A ruin? I can't really tell, and I don't really care. I just know that I need to get inside, no matter what.
It's much clearer here. I need to keep going down. I just wish I knew why.
Such a magnificent form! Burn his shape into your mind, Master, for that is the glory that one day awaits you as well!
You. I heard your footsteps echoing through the darkness. How long... how long have I been here?
Greed
They're after the Fang! Stop them, you fools!
Anyway, go back to sleep. See you in the morning.
Aww, come on, you've gotta be kidding me, piece of goddamn junk!
Be Careful
Boss, my bed's trashed. There's no place for me to sleep.
Boss, these beds ain't all that big. I don't know if we're both gonna fit.
Boss... are you sure? You've been sleeping on the ground just as much as I have.
Come here and get in with me, and keep it down.
Don't Go
Fuck, I am soaked! This place had better be dry!
Fuck. I guess I'll just keep watch until morning.
Hey, this place has beds and everything. Looks nice and dry too!
I ain't slept in a bed in months! I'm lookin' forward to this!
I don't think there's anything to worry about. Nothing's leaving home in this weather.
I'm just going to keep watch. No way I'm getting back to sleep now. See you in the morning, I guess.
Just hurry up while it's still warm.
Keep it Down
Right, whatever.
Share my Bed
Take my Bed
Thanks, boss. That means a lot.
We'll squeeze. Come on, nobody's sleeping on the floor tonight.
Yeah, fine, just cold and cranky.
You okay?
You take this bed. I'll keep watch.
You're the best. Thanks.

As a show of gratitude, let me offer you this piece of advice: stay clear of the center of the caldera, if you can. It houses the richest ruins, but far more powerful beings than you compete for them. T'would be better for you to skirt the rim, if wend you eastward.
His castle is in the mountains, should you wish an audience. Perhaps, if he is of a kind mood, he will grant you leave to pass. Perhaps not. It is for him to decide.
Magnificent! I am bound to his service no longer!
Now, I must go, for I am Lord of my own hunt, and you have earned the right to keep your blood! Bon soir!
Now, leave.
Turn back, warmblood. This road is owned by Lord Frico, and he suffers no trespassers.
You! You are the ones who have slain Lord Frico! I can yet smell his blood upon you.

Argh, I knew I should have poisoned the fountain! I won't be making THAT mistake again.
Find me in the next room if you ain't afraid to get a little blood on you.
Freshened up are we? Good, there's no more time to waste!
How do you figure you get as far as you do? Is it because you are strong, or is it because you gather strong people around you?
I can either reward you with fantastic riches, or with ancient and secret knowledge. What'll it be?
I'm expecting a good fight. Don't disappoint.
In order to make sure our well-paying spectators get to see the best fights, I'll be making this all interactive-like, and changing the fight depending on your answer. Fun, right?
It's not all bad though, right? I mean, you've got some valuable stuff on you, and now that you're half-dead and I've already seen all your moves, well... I won't even break a sweat. Goodnight,

Listen, you little shit, these profits are mine! You wiped out all of my biggest money-makers in the space of an hour! Nobody comes to an arena with no monsters in it! I'm ruined, and it's all your fault!
Nobody's got this far in quite a long time. Lookin' like you actually have a shot at the prize. That's great. Wonderful.
Not bad! Let's keep up the pressure.
Now, tell me how you would rather relax. Being surrounded with the faces of familiar people or being left alone with your thoughts in silence?

Oh, its you again. Thought you had me dead didn't you. Well, I'm not that easy to kill, I'll have you know. And though it pains me to let you in through here again, I am finding less adventurers willing to run this gauntlet. Well, the show must go on, have at thee.
Once you're in, though, you're in until you're either dead or out the other end, so if you're too scared, best you turn that delicate frame around and step out of here.
Oops, it looks like I wasn't able to get more monsters for that challenge. Oh well, I guess this one's on me. Please proceed to the next room.
Perfect! Ladies and gentlemen, I give you our champions! And champions... your reward!
So, here we go! What do you think is more important for a fighter? To be tough as hell, or to be flexible and adaptable?
Try not to die too fast. I paid good money for this.

Welcome to my arena, adventurers. I run a little business here you might be interested in. It's real simple. People pay to watch a good fight. You fight, and win, and you get a cut of the coin. Great, right?
Well, look at you. Made it all the way to the end, didn't you? And as promised, your amazingly valuable reward! Now if you noticed a theme here, I'm gonna give you a choice on your prize.
What is more important to you personally? Having a strong body, or a being well-known?
What sounds like a better place to spend all your riches when you win the jackpot? A cool boreal plateau or a warm beach?
You're stronger than you look. The crowd is most impressed. Now, though, it's time to get real.
You're the one who's competing? Maybe I should change my bets.
Oh God, not more sahaguin! Don't let them get me!
Got through all them zombers did ya? Cute.
Hold on, I smell blood. A lot of it. Something else, too...
I gotta wait here till someone wants to go, so tell me if you're in.
Lucky fer you, Frico and I, we're real good. You wanna see Frico, I can get you in. Hell, it's why good old Byrne is here, to guide folks like you to his frilly magnificence.
Storm shelter
There's a leech somewhere nearby. A vampire. Be on guard.
Well, I won't mess with you. If you're takin' this road, you must be headin' east, right? Frico controls the pass headin' that way.
